steps.name: QC and PCA to characterize the batch/condition confound
caveats: Do not attempt any batch-correction (ComBat, RUV, SVA, limma removeBatchEffect) here or downstream — with batch perfectly confounded with condition, such corrections would either be no-ops (collinear covariate dropped from the model) or would remove the biological signal along with any batch effect. Do not silently drop this caveat from the output.

Batch B1 = all 6 controls, batch B2 = all 6 treated. This step is diagnostic only, not a correction step, since batch and condition are mathematically inseparable in this design.
steps.question: Given that batch B1 contains all 6 controls and batch B2 contains all 6 treated samples, what does the sample-level structure (library size, PCA, hierarchical clustering) of the 12000 x 12 raw count matrix look like, and does it show a dominant axis of separation consistent with batch=condition?
acceptance_criteria: Library size / count distribution reported per sample
PCA (on variance-stabilized or log-CPM data) computed and PC1/PC2 plotted colored by condition/batch (which are identical labels here)
Report explicitly states that condition and batch cannot be distinguished from this structure alone because they are perfectly collinear
Output table of per-sample QC metrics saved

steps.name: Differential expression: treated vs control (batch-confounded)
caveats: Because batch B1 holds all controls and B2 holds all treated, adding batch to the model formula (~condition + batch) is not possible — it is perfectly collinear with condition and will produce a rank-deficient design matrix / NA coefficients in DESeq2. Use ~condition only and report the confound as a limitation, not as resolved.
If salmon counts are not integer (fractional due to quantification), round before passing to DESeq2, and note this in the output.

Do not interpret the resulting gene list as a clean treatment signature — state plainly that batch effects (library prep, processing day, etc.) are fully aliased with condition and cannot be excluded as an alternative explanation for any and all of the observed differences.
steps.context: Raw counts from counts.csv (gene-level, from salmon, length-correction status unknown per profile) and metadata.csv (condition: treated/control; batch: B1=control, B2=treated, perfectly confounded). Standard DESeq2 workflow: build DESeqDataSet from count matrix and colData, filter low-count genes, run DESeq() with design ~condition, extract results with lfcShrink (apeglm) for the treated-vs-control contrast.
steps.question: Using DESeq2 on the raw gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples), which genes are differentially expressed between the 6 treated and 6 control samples, understanding that this contrast is identical to a B2-vs-B1 batch contrast because condition and batch are perfectly confounded in this design?
acceptance_criteria: DESeq2 run with design ~condition (batch cannot be added as a covariate — it is aliased with condition and the model would be unidentifiable)
Results table with log2FoldChange, p-value, and BH-adjusted p-value (padj) for all ~12000 genes
Significant gene list at padj < 0.05 reported with counts of up/down-regulated genes
Output explicitly labeled and captioned that the DE list reflects the combined treatment+batch effect and cannot be attributed to treatment alone due to the confound
MA plot and volcano plot saved

steps.name: Pathway enrichment on the confounded DE gene list
caveats: This step only enriches interpretability; it cannot resolve or bypass the underlying batch confound. Any pathway signal here is exactly as confounded as the gene list it is built from and must be reported with that same caveat, not as independent confirmation of a treatment effect.
steps.context: Use the DESeq2 differential expression results (gene symbols, log2FoldChange, padj) from T1S2 as input. Reference gene sets: WikiPathways human pathways available at /mnt/refs/managed/wikipathways-human/2026.07.10/wikipathways_Homo_sapiens.gmt (HGNC gene symbols, '%'-delimited descriptor per line — split on '%' to recover the pathway name).
steps.question: Which WikiPathways human pathways are enriched among the genes differentially expressed between treated and control lung samples, reported with the caveat that the underlying gene list reflects a batch-confounded contrast?
acceptance_criteria: Enrichment run (e.g., over-representation or GSEA-style ranked test) using the DESeq2 results from T1S2 against WikiPathways human gene sets
Output table of enriched pathways with adjusted p-values

Report explicitly repeats the batch-confound caveat from T1S2 alongside the pathway results, since any enriched pathway could equally reflect a technical/batch signature rather than a treatment-driven biological process

plan.title: Confounded batch/condition DE analysis with caveat reporting
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset (12000 genes x 13 columns for 12 samples, raw salmon-derived counts) has batch B1 = all controls and B2 = all treated — condition and batch are perfectly confounded. This means no computational method (ComBat, RUV, SVA, including-batch-as-covariate in the DE model) can separate a condition effect from a batch effect: they are mathematically identical in this design. Any standard batch-correction step would either do nothing (because the batch variable is collinear with the design variable and gets dropped or absorbed) or would remove the condition signal along with the batch signal. The only honest path is to run the differential expression analysis as a simple two-group comparison (treated vs control) using a negative-binomial model appropriate for raw counts, flag explicitly that the resulting gene list reflects batch+condition combined and cannot be attributed to treatment alone, and follow with lightweight diagnostics (PCA/sample clustering, and a check of how many top DE genes are also associated with known technical/batch-driven patterns such as extreme fold changes or house-keeping-gene shifts) so the report can characterize the confound's practical impact rather than pretend it doesn't exist. A downstream pathway enrichment step is included for interpretability, but its output must be reported with the same caveat. No steps are added that would misrepresent the confound as resolved.
